From: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@aquafin.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Customer Hero Spotlight — interested!

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for reaching out — we'd be happy to participate as a customer reference and appear in the "Hero Spotlight" blog. A few quick questions from our side before we confirm:

- Are there any incentives for participating (credits, swag, donation)?
- If a donation option exists, can we get an official receipt addressed to AquaFin Legal (legal@aquafin.com) for our records?
- Timeline: when would the story be published?

We're leaning toward a donation to a local charity rather than taking swag. Let me know what options look like.

Best,
Sofia Ramirez
Head of Platform Partnerships
AquaFin LLC

Subject: Re: Customer Hero Spotlight — incentives and logistics

Hi Sofia — great to hear, and thank you!

Short answers up front: we can offer (pick one) — a $2,000 account credit, a Redwood swag pack (hoodie + backpack + stickers), or a $500 donation to a charity of your choice. We can also split between credit + swag if preferred.

If you pick donation, we will process it through finance and issue an official receipt addressed to AquaFin Legal (please confirm exact legal name and email). If you pick swag, Marissa will coordinate shipping.

Estimated publishing timeline: draft by Feb 18, publish by Feb 25 (we can adjust).

I attached the swag options so you can see what we typically send (swag_pack_options.pdf).

Would you like the donation to be to a US 501(c)(3) (we can provide charity vetting), or is there a specific organization you prefer?

Thanks — Tessa
